content.statement: A person who, for a non-natural use of land, brings a dangerous thing likely to do mischief if it escapes, is strictly liable upon escape and damage, subject to established exceptions.
content.development: English rule in Rylands v. Fletcher, received and applied with caution in India; contrasted with absolute liability.
content.application: Classical water-reservoir and analogous escape cases; check exceptions before advising absolute recovery.
